name: Ethel Matenge-Sebesho
bio: Ethel Matenge-Sebesho is an experienced banker and financial services expert and has served on the board of FirstRand Limited. She continues to serve on the board of some subsidiaries of FirstRand Limited and Distell Group Limited. Until the end of 2017, Ethel was involved with establishing new markets for Home Finance Guarantors Africa Reinsurance in a number of African countries.
